question: Which state topped the medal tally of the Khelo India Youth Games 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Maharashtra topped the medal tally at the Khelo India Youth Games 2024, showcasing its dominance in various sports disciplines.
 
• The state secured the highest number of gold medals, followed by a significant tally of silver and bronze medals.
 
• Maharashtra’s success is attributed to its strong sports infrastructure and government-backed training programs for young athletes.
 
• The state has consistently performed well in previous editions of the Khelo India Youth Games, underlining its commitment to sports development.
 
• Sports like athletics, swimming, and wrestling were key contributors to Maharashtra's medal tally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Madhya Pradesh**

 
 
• Madhya Pradesh has emerged as a strong competitor in the Khelo India Youth Games in recent years, with significant investments in sports facilities and training programs.
 
• The state is particularly known for its performance in sports like hockey, archery, and athletics.
 
• In the 2024 edition, Madhya Pradesh finished among the top-ranking states, reflecting its growing emphasis on nurturing young talent.
 
 
 
• **Manipur**
 
 
• Manipur, a small state in northeastern India, has an impressive track record in sports, often punching above its weight in national competitions.
 
• The state is renowned for producing world-class athletes in disciplines like weightlifting, boxing, and football.
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan**
 
 
• Rajasthan has been making strides in sports development, with a focus on promoting traditional sports alongside modern disciplines.
 
• The state has invested in infrastructure and training to enhance its performance in national competitions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Khelo India Youth Games**

 
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is a national-level multidisciplinary grassroots sports event in India aimed at promoting youth sports and identifying young talent.
 
• It was launched in 2018 under the Khelo India program by the Government of India to revive the sports culture in the country.
 
• The event includes a wide range of sports disciplines, providing a platform for young athletes to showcase their skills.
 
• The Games have been instrumental in identifying and nurturing future sports stars for India’s international sporting ambitions.
